hypotheses.reasoning: GET /search latency and 504s originate in search-api's product queries against catalog-db. The earliest search-side anomaly is catalog-svc /products/batch slowing (#2196, 3019ms). The first database-side anomaly is a sequential scan on audit_log in catalog-db (#2809, 2178ms, 18:36:45), the only slow catalog-db query before 18:40 and the first sign of DB load. Shortly after, catalog-db reports connection slots nearly full with CPU at 96-100% (#3233, #3355, #3554). Products lookups then slow to 4-8.5s (#3502, #3631), and search-api queries on products time out at 5s (#3684). The web-bff 504s are downstream and not cited. The DB is slow rather than failing fast, which fits dependency_timeout. The metrics-agent queue drops, the status-poller timeouts to the deprecated legacy-inventory endpoint, and the audit-consumer RangeError crash (#3515) are unrelated to the search path. Caveat: the source of the audit_log scan is not visible in the logs.

verdict.recommendedAction: Identify the caller issuing the unindexed audit_log seq scan (#2809) and stop it or add an index on audit_log(created_at). Then confirm catalog-db CPU and connections recover. Separately, triage the audit-consumer RangeError (#3515) and the status-poller's use of the deprecated legacy-inventory endpoint (#3262).
